name: VivaDicta
title_zh: 离线也能听懂你说话的AI语音键盘，边录边聊自己的笔记
tagline_zh: 开会口述转文字，问它“我上周说的预算数字”，不用联网、不用翻笔记。Apple 芯片本地跑 WhisperKit。
tagline_en: Dictate, then ask "what was that budget figure?" — answers from your notes, on-device. WhisperKit locally, 20+.
desc_en: iOS & watchOS speech-to-text app with AI voice keyboard, on-device RAG, and chat with your notes - powered by Apple Foundation Models, WhisperKit, NVIDIA Parakeet, and 20+ AI providers
why_zh: 别人只做听写，它把听写和检索缝成一个动作：说完话直接问自己的笔记，RAG 在本地跑，隐私和速度同时给到。
why_en: Others just transcribe. This one stitches speech and retrieval: dictate, then ask your own notes — RAG runs on-device, so.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 iOS/watchOS；首次要下载语音模型（约 1GB+）；本地 RAG 仅索引你手动导入的笔记。
limit_en: iOS/watchOS only; first-run model download ~1GB+; local RAG indexes only notes you import, not system Memos; poor on complex tables or handwritten.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: AI voice keyboard that types & chats with your notes.
